name: Regular Planning Commission Meeting
agenda_text:
CHAIRPERSON BACOLOD

  VICE-CHAIR UTTECHT

  COMMISSIONER SOUSA  COMMISSIONER THAPA

  COMMISSIONER DIAZ

  CITY OF ARTESIA
  REGULAR PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
  Tuesday, January 15, 2019
  Artesia City Council Chambers
  18747 Clarkdale Avenue
  (562) 865-6262
  6:30 p.m.

1.  Call to Order

2.  Invocation

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

4.  Roll Call of Commission

5.  Approval of Agenda

6.  Announcement of Speaker Slips

  For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item
  on the agenda, please complete a Speaker Slip located in the lobby or at the
  podium and deposit it with the Planning Aide prior to the commencement of the
  meeting. Please note that there is a five-minute time limit per speaker imposed.
  Please stay within this time limit.

7.  Public Comments on Any Items Not on the Agenda

8.  Administration of the Oath

  At this time anyone desiring to speak on a public hearing item should stand and
  be sworn in by the Deputy City Attorney.

9.  New Business – Public Hearing

  A.  Case No. 2018-28
  Design Review  11727 Arkansas Street

  JAM Family Investments LLC, 11727 Arkansas Street, Artesia, CA 90701

  1
   A request for approval of a Design Review application to allow the
  demolition of an existing 2,843 square foot office building and the
  construction of a new 3,331 square foot office building on real property
  located at 11727 Arkansas Street in the Light Manufacturing and Industrial
  (M-1) Zone, and making a determination of categorical Class 2 exemption
  under CEQA.
  Staff Report
  Resolution No. 2019-01P

  B.  Case No. 2018-30
  Design Review  12215 E. South Street

  Mr. Alex A. Irshaid, 670 E. Parkridge Avenue, Ste. 101, Corona, CA 92879

  A request for approval of a Design Review application for the remodel of the
  existing six “Gilbarco B-85” fuel dispensers and replacing them with six new
  “Gilbarco Encore 700 S” fuel dispensers at the existing Shell gas station on
  real property located at 12215 E. South Street in the Commercial General
  (C-G) Zone, and making a determination of categorical Class 2 exemption
  under CEQA.
  Staff Report
  Resolution No. 2019-02P

10.  New Business – Non Public Hearing (None)

11.  Report Items (None)

12.  Discussion/Additional Items from Staff (None)

13.  Additional Citizens’ Comments

14.  Items from the Commission

Adjournment to the next Regular Planning Commission Meeting to be held on
Tuesday, February 19, 2019, at 6:30 p.m., in the City of Artesia Council Chambers.
The City of Artesia complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please
contact the Planning Department at (562) 865-6262 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
